import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r: break
  fs.append(f)
for i in range(len(fs)):
  cv2.putText(fs[i],str(i),(10,30),0,1,(0,0,255),2)
sel=list(range(52,76))
rows=[np.hstack([cv2.resize(fs[i][150:500],(480,175)) for i in sel[j:j+4]]) for j in range(0,24,4)]
cv2.imwrite('dbg/grid2.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
bg=fs[0].astype(int)
for i in range(45,85):
  d=(np.abs(fs[i].astype(int)-bg).sum(2)>60).astype(np.uint8)
  d=cv2.morphologyEx(d,cv2.MORPH_OPEN,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
  ys,xs=np.nonzero(d[60:])
  if len(xs)>200: print(i,len(xs),xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min()+60,ys.max()+60)
"
